# KaTeX 0.16.22

Local runtime subset: `dist/katex.min.js`, `dist/katex.min.css`, all files in
`dist/fonts/`, and the MIT `LICENSE`. Copied byte-for-byte from the existing
`01_intro/vendor/katex/` distribution so lecture 02 can load its math resources
when only `02_linalg/` is served. No CDN or sibling-directory dependency.

Upstream package: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.22.tgz
